notes.title: Patch Note 0.34
notes.content:
[b]Patch Note 0.34[/b] is now live! Here is our first update for INTERASTRA, we are not slowing down! We listen to your valuable feedback, and we try to make our production meet all expectations! As previously reported, we will systematically publish improvements!

This is a list of the latest changes:

[b]Fixed:[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed the battery regeneration exploit
[*]Translation repair
[*]Add-on food/hydration repair
[*]Collapsing repair (S4-N99)
[*]Outline of the blueprint repair
[*]Improving the running / walking sound when the player is on the platform
[*]Interest points do not reset to their initial state when the game is loaded
[*]Repair of picking Small Power Cell and Large Power Cell system
[/list]

[b]Updated:[/b]

[list]
[*]The thirst and hunger bar decrease speed has been reduced by 20%
[*]New equipment icons have been added that allow items to be thrown or destroyed
[*]The corridor has been rebuilt, M5-HR00M (Ruins)
[*]The lowered the temperature on the S4-N99 5 degrees down
[*]When building a rocket, only the space where the player has to put the item is shown
[*]The blue glow effect of already made rocket components has been turned off
[*]The player has more influence on the direction he moves during the fall, value changed from 0.002 to 0.003
[*]One of the opponents' health has decreased (50%)
[*]Object edges no longer block the player
[*]Health regenerated by nanobots has been reduced by 50%
[*]A voice prompt is triggered when your health drops below 25 points
[*]A voice prompt is triggered when your oxygen level drops below 25 points
[*]A voice prompt is triggered when your temperature level is too low or too high
[*]Damage taken from bad heat reduced by 33% (ranging from 40-41 and 33-32), old damage is applied beyond these values
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/rSRrwbCCyH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/b746340a79a1afe28c1317ef5f3f07f06d59ce36.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

Another mission is calling you! A new planet has been discovered that can give hope and answers to many questions. Prepare your space rocket, take the necessary supplies and equipment, and set off on an adventure full of dangers. The Desert Planet is waiting for you open!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/0a48a801159ec33b8bed2f038ce6516b31abff9c.png[/img]

In such a place, the temperature can exceed unimaginable heat.  Without the spacesuit adapted to these conditions, you won’t survive. Dry wastelands without access to water can be fatal. The most important thing is to stock up well before each travel. The Desert Planet also hides various treasures and puzzles. Be careful and watch your steps. You can expect adversity on every corner. Going too deep, you may not be able to go back. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/fc74807ae2df376884675dbe8a1ae8fe0a618edb.png[/img]

In INTERASTRA there are still many new things for you. We care about your feedback, and we wanted to ask how do you like the look of this planet? Feel free in the comments below. Additionally, we invite you to discuss on Discord, where we can talk about the news!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Welcome to the next devlog!

As we know, one of your main goals is to survive on unknown planets. A variety of problems and obstacles awaits you, which will definitely hinder your mission. You should be well prepared and learn the secrets of crafting. Certainly, such a skill will help you achieve the desired goal, and you will learn how to properly use the encountered resources to create various components or tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/10c8589c4f27e81a5edee6bfa6b1935e11305d26.png[/img]

In the course of your adventure, it is possible to use a crafting table. This is the device to create assets. All types are categorized, making it much easier to navigate in the interface (for example: Consumables, Tools, Components, etc. ).
It is very important to explore and collect materials needed for crafting. For instance, to create a first aid kit, you have to collect the correct amount of Plant Material, or Mechanical Parts will be made with Iron Ores. The whole thing, of course, is in the form of a tree.

Travels between planets will be possible thanks to the modern rocket. You will have to figure out how to build it with available parts, firstly understand what it should look like and what amount to assemble for the machine to work. The system will be developed and expanded so that everyone can feel like a real conqueror of space.

In INTERASTRA, be ready for a wonderful adventure crowned with dangers, puzzles, and the art of survival. It is up to you how your interplanetary adventure will go. Prepare yourself accordingly for travel!

We appreciate your attention. Share in the comments section what your feelings are. We are curious about your opinion. Additionally, we encourage you to visit our social media!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

In today’s devlog I’ll show you what else is hidden in the ruins. Nothing will be served on the tray, to survive you have to solve various mysteries. Each place hides something different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/03c96c828c97aba7c8cada78227b12687f7cbcfa.png[/img]

To find out, what does the symbol means, you need to arrange the segments in the correct shape. You will have to be patient, but also you need luck. Without these qualities, you will not move on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/36f35e2116f436fab572b4f02ac20ff40ba3aa28.png[/img]

This place will test both your memory and also your precision. Every daredevil must decode the password. What awaits you after a successful trial? You will see for yourself!

These and other challenges await you in different parts of the world. Let us know if you have any ideas for other puzzles in the comment section below. Don’t forget to join our Discord.

[url=https://discord.gg/X8ycrYH6mF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/b746340a79a1afe28c1317ef5f3f07f06d59ce36.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello Space traveler!

Today we will talk about the next two planets! 

First we will discuss Ice Planet. As you may guess the weather there will be quite cold so prepare yourself that your first challenge will be not to freeze to death. Find a shelter from snowstorms, figure out how to warm up yourself. 

Probably finding water won’t be such a problem (you can always melt the ice) as finding food, which could be hidden under the snow and ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/31ba9c50b256dbf58ad3bd390b55c4508a329d13.png[/img]

Besides the weather which can change, sometimes for worse, sometimes for better, there are also other dangers which lurk on you. Watch out for falling icicles, breaking ice on the water, and enemies…

Do you feel cold? I will warm you up by telling you about the next planet - Desert Planet. You will miss the ice one!

Probably if Anakin played INTERASTRA that wouldn’t be his favorite planet because sand is everywhere and as we know...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/53b22abb002ec61eddd8c609b2e0b49d60df2179.jpg[/img]

Sand is not the only problem here but it could also be dangerous because of quicksands and sand storms. So be careful where you stand your feet cause you might fall into a deadly trap. Sand is also a perfect lodge for something which may hide there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/3a29cddbbf4cbaea43bc70c2deecdb5f2e2eaa3d.png[/img]

But the biggest problems for you aren’t enemies, sandstorms, or even exploding cactus (yes you can find it here) but the temperature and lack of water. On the previous planet, you tried not to freeze to death, here you try not to overheat. It won’t be easy. Sometimes the weather can help you but I don’t recommend confiding in something which can change easily to your disadvantage. You have to figure out something else. Sometimes you can find an oasis where you will have some water and shadow. 

On Ice Planet you will be surrounded by ice walls, caves etc which might cause you to feel trapped. Otherwise, on the Desert Planet there is a planty of empty space which may make you feel lonely. On both planets you can find unique supplies which can be very useful.

In the end I will mention that before every trip to any planet you have to prepare yourself. Choose the right suit, tools, equipment and provision. Soon I will tell you more about it so stay tuned! 

That’s all for today. See you next time! Don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on Instagram! 

[url=https://discord.gg/5q3xm3EmSn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/b746340a79a1afe28c1317ef5f3f07f06d59ce36.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Devlog #1 | Ruins
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Welcome to 1st INTERASTRA’s devlog. Today I will tell you a little bit about ruins which you can find in the game. 

Every planet will ultimately have its own ruins which are the legacy of other civilizations. Who were they? I can’t tell you now but they are part of the story line. The ruins are mostly hidden so your job will be to find them. Sometimes it can be not so easy but soon or later you will see that you are close. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/c2f33ed980e0c7074bfe021964436ad506e8cd61.png[/img]

Inside you can find not only many different supplies but also mysteries and challenges  which solving will lead you to the answers of questions like “Who built it? Why? And what does this have to do with you?”. At the end of every ruin you will find an artefact or a part of it which will be necessary to win this game. 

You can feel a little bit overwhelmed by these places but be aware, because danger lurks in every corner. There’re traps and enemies which can hurt you badly so have your eyes wide open. Otherwise you will become a new part of the interior design of ruins. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040435/b9b59847eb850011111155d720f6042779741e92.png[/img]

Soon I will tell you more about enemies but that's all for today. Let us know in the comments if you like it or if you have any questions and join our Discord!

notes.title: Demo Update - Patch 0.11
notes.content:
Hello Astronauts!

First of all, we want to thank you for playing the INTERASTRA and giving us feedback.  That means a lot to us and thanks to you and your suggestion we will be able to make our game even better! 

And now let's get back to the topic. We realize the first update after which you get:

[list]
[*] The ability to set mouse sensitivity and invert,
[*] The feedback button in the main menu and end screen,
[*] Menu visual change - addition of hyperlinks to community pages,
[*] Minor bug fixes and optimizations (for example blocking in mushrooms).
[/list]

We hope that you will like it and have more fun playing INTERASTRA. We are open to your suggestions so don't be afraid of giving us feedback, after all, we create our games to bring YOU joy :)
